content.stem: 政府金融情报机构(FIU)的职责有哪些？(选择三项.)

options.A: 向外国司法系统传播可疑交易和可疑活动报告的分析结果,以增强其反洗钱和反恐融资的调查及起诉工作.
options.B: 接收报告机构或义务机构提交的可疑交易和可疑活动报告
options.C: 向当地执法机构和外国金融情报机构传播可疑交易和可疑活动报告的分析结果,以打击洗钱活动
options.D: 对从报告机构或义务机构收到的所有可疑交易和可疑活动报告进行调查,并在适当情况下提起诉讼
options.E: 分析从报告机构或义务机构收到的所有可疑交易和可疑活动报告

content.stem_en: What are the roles of a government Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU)? (Select three.)

options_en.A: Disseminate analysis of suspicious transaction and suspicious activity reports to foreign judicial systems to enhance their anti-money laundering and terrorist financing investigations and prosecutions.
options_en.B: Receive reports of suspicious transactions and suspicious activities from reporting institutions or obliged institutions.
options_en.C: Disseminate the analysis of suspicious transaction and suspicious activity reports to local law enforcement agencies and foreign FIUs to combat money laundering.
options_en.D: Investigate all suspicious transaction and suspicious activity reports received from reporting institutions or obliged institutions and prosecute cases where appropriate.
options_en.E: Analyze all suspicious transaction and suspicious activity reports received from reporting institutions or obliged institutions.
